label: 默认服务商
description: Startup provider (e.g., `"anthropic"`, `"openai"`; saved with Ctrl+S in `/model`, or edited manually)

label: 默认模型
description: Startup model ID (saved with Ctrl+S in `/model`, or edited manually)

label: 默认思考强度
description: Startup thinking level (saved with Ctrl+S in `/thinking`, or edited manually): `"off"`, `"minimal"`, `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`, `"xhigh"`, `"max"`

label: 按模型设置强度
description: Per-model startup thinking levels keyed by `"provider/modelId"`; configure from `/settings` → Default thinking level per model or edit manually

label: 隐藏思考块
description: Hide thinking blocks in output

label: 缓存未命中通知
description: Show transcript notices for significant prompt-cache misses, compaction or branch-summary usage, and provider recovery diagnostics such as dropped Anthropic thinking blocks

label: 思考 Token 预算
description: Custom token budgets per thinking level. Anthropic, Google, and Bedrock use these natively. OpenAI-compatible models use them when `compat.thinkingTokenBudgetField` (or `supportsThinkingTokenBudget`) is set.

label: Pi 终端主题
description: Theme name (`"dark"`, `"light"`, or custom)

label: 外部编辑器
default: $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then Notepad on Windows or nano elsewhere
description: Command for Ctrl+G external editor; takes precedence over environment variables

label: 安静启动
description: Hide startup header

label: 默认项目信任
description: Fallback project trust behavior: `"ask"`, `"always"`, or `"never"`. Global setting only

label: 折叠更新日志
description: Show condensed changelog after updates

label: 匿名安装统计
description: Send the anonymous install/update ping and selected provider attribution headers. This does not control update checks

label: 使用分析
description: Opt-in analytics data sharing. Currently only asked for during the experimental first-time setup (`PI_EXPERIMENTAL=1`)

label: 追踪标识
description: Analytics tracking identifier, generated when `enableAnalytics` is turned on

label: 双 Escape 行为
description: Action for double-escape: `"tree"`, `"fork"`, or `"none"`

label: 历史树默认筛选
description: Default filter for `/tree`: `"default"`, `"no-tools"`, `"user-only"`, `"labeled-only"`, `"all"`

label: 编辑器水平边距
description: Horizontal padding for input editor (0-3)

label: 输出间距
description: Horizontal padding for user messages, assistant messages, and thinking (0 or 1)

label: 补全列表最大条目
description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

label: 硬件光标
description: Show the terminal cursor while TUI positions it for IME support

label: 终端模式
description: Interactive TUI mode: `"regular"` or experimental `"fullscreen"`. Changes from `/settings` apply immediately; `--tui-mode` overrides this setting at startup

label: 全屏退出输出
description: Fullscreen exit output: `"transcript"` prints the final transcript and resume hint, while `"resume-hint"` restores the previous screen and prints only the resume hint. Has no effect in regular TUI mode

label: 全屏滚动条
description: Fullscreen transcript scrollbar: `"auto"` shows it temporarily while scrolling or while the pointer is over its rightmost-column track, `"always"` reserves that column and keeps it visible, and `"hidden"` hides it. Has no effect in regular TUI mode

label: 选中即复制
description: Automatically copy selected text in fullscreen mode. When disabled, selections stay highlighted and `Ctrl+X` copies the active selection

label: HTTP 代理
description: HTTP proxy URL applied as `HTTP_PROXY` and `HTTPS_PROXY`. Global setting only.

label: Anthropic 额外用量提示
description: Show a warning when Anthropic subscription auth may use paid extra usage

label: 启用自动压缩
description: Enable auto-compaction

label: 预留输出 Token
description: Tokens reserved for LLM response

label: 保留最近 Token
description: Recent tokens to keep (not summarized)

label: 分支摘要预留 Token
description: Tokens reserved when selecting branch history; output is capped at 4096 tokens

label: 跳过摘要询问
description: Skip "Summarize branch?" prompt on `/tree` navigation (defaults to no summary)

label: 启用重试
description: Enable automatic agent-level retry on transient errors

label: 最大重试次数
description: Maximum agent-level retry attempts

label: 初始延迟（毫秒）
description: Base delay for agent-level exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s)

label: 服务商请求超时（毫秒）
description: Provider/SDK request timeout in milliseconds

label: 服务商重试次数
description: Provider/SDK retry attempts

label: 服务商最大等待（毫秒）
description: Max server-requested delay before failing (60s)

label: Steering 投递方式
description: How steering messages are sent: `"all"` or `"one-at-a-time"`

label: Follow-up 投递方式
description: How follow-up messages are sent: `"all"` or `"one-at-a-time"`

label: 请求传输
description: Preferred transport for providers that support multiple transports: `"sse"`, `"websocket"`, `"websocket-cached"`, or `"auto"`

label: HTTP 空闲超时（毫秒）
description: HTTP header/body idle timeout in milliseconds, also used by providers with explicit stream idle timeouts. Set to `0` to disable.

label: WebSocket 连接超时（毫秒）
description: WebSocket connect/open handshake timeout in milliseconds for providers that support WebSocket transports. Set to `0` to disable.

label: 终端显示图片
description: Show images in terminal (if supported)

label: 终端图片宽度
description: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells

label: 内容缩小时清屏
description: Clear empty rows when content shrinks (can cause flicker)

label: 终端超链接
description: Override OSC 8 hyperlink support (advanced, JSON-only)

label: 终端图片协议
description: Override image protocol support with `"kitty"`, `"iterm2"`, `false`, or `"auto"` (advanced, JSON-only)

label: 终端真彩色
description: Override truecolor support (advanced, JSON-only)

label: 自动缩放图片
description: Resize images to 2000x2000 max. Applies to `@file` attachments, `read`, and images returned by tools

label: 禁止发送图片
description: Block all images from being sent to LLM

label: Shell 路径
description: Custom shell path (e.g., for Cygwin on Windows); supports a leading `~` for the home directory

label: Shell 命令前缀
description: Prefix for every bash command (e.g., `"shopt -s expand_aliases"`)

label: npm 命令
description: Command argv used for npm package lookup/install operations (e.g., `["mise", "exec", "node@20", "--", "npm"]`)

label: 默认内置工具
description: Built-in tools enabled initially. When omitted, Pi uses its standard defaults

label: 会话目录
description: Directory where session files are stored. Accepts absolute or relative paths, plus `~`.

label: 模型轮换范围
description: Model patterns for Ctrl+P cycling (same format as `--models` CLI flag)

label: 代码块缩进
description: Indentation for code blocks

label: Mermaid 渲染
description: Mermaid rendering mode: `"off"`, `"final"`, or `"streaming"`

label: 包来源与资源过滤
description: npm/git packages to load resources from

label: 扩展路径
description: Local extension file paths or directories

label: 技能路径
description: Local skill file paths or directories

label: 提示词路径
description: Local prompt template paths or directories

label: 主题路径
description: Local theme file paths or directories

label: 启用技能命令
description: Register skills as `/skill:name` commands
